reason: I do one big shop a week with a mental list and I'm not going to scan receipts and log every item I buy and use. The free version might sit on my phone, but paying $4 a month for something that needs that much effort, no.
objection: I won't keep logging every item I buy and use. If I have to feed it every week it will be dead in two weeks and I'll be paying for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: If the receipt scan truly did everything on its own, including Arabic receipts from Carrefour, and a free month showed it saved me real food waste without me touching anything else.
